## Meta Exceeds Q2 Expectations but Shares Drop on Forward Concerns

A beat-but-drop pattern signals the market is anchored on forward capex and AI ROI visibility, not trailing results; this dynamic mirrors ARM's post-earnings behavior (cluster 4bb23f81) and suggests a broader market pattern of skepticism toward near-term AI spending returns that is overriding headline earnings performance.

- Meta's Q2 results exceeded consensus expectations for the quarter per this cluster's headline coverage.
- Despite the beat, shares declined—indicating the market is focused on forward guidance or capex trajectory rather than trailing results.
- Note: cluster 30066c975 characterizes Q2 as an earnings miss; outlets differ on beat vs. miss—the discrepancy may reflect different metric lines (e.g., revenue beat vs. EPS miss) or varying consensus benchmarks.
- The negative stock reaction is consistent across all META clusters, making it the clearest signal regardless of the beat/miss resolution.
